item.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: 385x more efficient inference
item.description:
📝 To enable this, we introduce Energy-Based Reasoners (EBRs), which learn an energy function over latent reasoning states and formulate looped updates as gradient descent on this energy. EBRs give the best single-sample accuracy among reasoning models. Stopping each trajectory once its energy gradient falls below a threshold keeps 99.
🔗 Read more: https://energy-based-reasoners.github.io/

item.title: Australia's full national topographic library at your fingertips
item.description:

Branch Head of Geoscience Australia’s National Location Information Branch, Lisa Bush, said‘This is Australia’s national topographic library, modernised and in your pocket. Browse the full AUSTopo 1:250,000 topographic map series, download maps for offline use, or print a copy when you need one.
